wire.headline: Utility Firm Reports Profit Fall and Job Cuts
sentences: Revenue rose 7% year-on-year to 4.26bn GBP for the quarter ending 30 September.
Pre-tax profit declined by 12% to 310m GBP.
The company announced 850 job cuts, which represents about 6% of its workforce.
Two gas plants, one located in Wales and one in Kent, will close by March 2027.
CEO Marian Holt stated that cost pressure was sharper than expected.
Ofgem has opened an investigation into the company's billing system.
The dividend was held at 12.4p a share.

ND.headline: UK Energy Firm Announces Job Cuts and Profit Decline

sentences.text: The company reported a pre-tax profit of 310m GBP, marking a 12% decline.
A total of 850 jobs are to be cut, which represents about 6% of the workforce.
A Kestrel Securities analyst stated that the job cuts will save 90m GBP a year.
Unite has announced it will ballot members on taking industrial action.
The Kent plant employs 410 staff, leaving the local supply chain exposed.
